Hero.headline: Men's Underwear OEM & ODM for Global Brands
Hero.lede: In-house manufacturing from sourcing to shipment.

ServicesOverview.headline: More than a factory — a development partner.
ServicesOverview.description: OEM production, ODM development, fabric sourcing, pattern-making, and full private-label support. Every step handled in-house at our Zhongshan facility.
ServicesOverview.s1Desc: Bring your tech pack. We handle fabric sourcing, pattern grading, and bulk production to your exact specs.
ServicesOverview.s2Desc: Start from our in-house design library — fabric, waistband, and fit already validated. Development in as few as 4 weeks.
ServicesOverview.s3Desc: Custom waistband jacquard, cotton / modal / bamboo blends, multi-size fit development for regional body standards.
ServicesOverview.s4Desc: Proto, fit, and PP samples in 10–14 days. Hang tags, poly bags, printed inner waistband — fully white-labeled.

ProductSpecialization.headline: Six core categories, engineered in-house.
ProductSpecialization.description: Three foundational silhouettes and three specialized fabric lines. Each category carries its own pattern library, approved fabric partners, and tolerance spec.
ProductSpecialization.boxerBriefsTag: Mid-thigh length with balanced coverage, the bestseller category
ProductSpecialization.trunksTag: Shorter leg for contemporary lifestyle and fashion-forward lines
ProductSpecialization.seamlessTag: Bonded and ultrasonic-cut construction, zero visible lines
ProductSpecialization.modalTag: MicroModal and TENCEL™ blends for premium hand-feel at outlet-friendly MOQs
ProductSpecialization.performanceTag: Moisture-wicking compression, mesh panels, and reinforced stitching for athletic lines

WhyChooseUs.headline: Built for brands who can't afford to compromise.
WhyChooseUs.description: A vertically integrated men's underwear manufacturer, not a trading agent. Every step of the chain is owned and accountable to the same team.
WhyChooseUs.a1Desc: 20 years on a single category. Every pattern, machine, and operator is tuned to men's underwear — not a general apparel factory running underwear on the side.
WhyChooseUs.a2Desc: Both construction methods under one roof. Most factories pick one — we run parallel lines for either, and can combine both in a single SKU.
WhyChooseUs.a3Desc: Bring your tech pack, or start from our design library. Switch modes between SKUs in the same PO.
WhyChooseUs.a4Desc: AQL 2.5 inspection on every shipment, metal detection on every piece, and final measurement checks before packing.
WhyChooseUs.a5Desc: Same line, same QC standard — whether you're testing a capsule or scaling a bestseller. No downgrade on small runs.
WhyChooseUs.a6Desc: Tech pack → sourcing → production → packaging → export docs. One point of contact from inquiry to shipment.

OrderProcess.headline: From inquiry to shipment — a 7-step process, fully tracked.
OrderProcess.description: Every order follows the same documented workflow — no surprises on price, timeline, or quality.
OrderProcess.s1Desc: Share product type, fabric, quantity, and custom details.
OrderProcess.s2Desc: Unit price, lead time, sample cost, setup fees, and shipping — all itemized within 24 hours.
OrderProcess.s3Desc: Mockup → sample production → your evaluation → final approval. Revisions supported.
OrderProcess.s4Desc: 30–50% deposit. Fabric sourcing → cutting → printing / embroidery → sewing → in-line QC.
OrderProcess.s5Desc: Full pre-shipment inspection + OPP bags / gift boxes / cartons + photo confirmation before dispatch.
OrderProcess.s6Desc: Balance payment, then shipment via your preferred logistics method with full export documents.
OrderProcess.s7Desc: Arrival inspection + resolution for any issues. Order closed on your confirmation.
OrderProcess.ctaText: Ready to start your custom underwear project?

CapabilitySnapshot.headline: A Zhongshan-based facility built for men's underwear manufacturing.
CapabilitySnapshot.description: Located in Guangdong's knit-manufacturing cluster, our vertically integrated facility covers seamless knitting, cut-and-sew, printing, and full packout — all under one roof.

Certifications.headline: Audited, documented, and export-ready.
Certifications.description: Compliance documentation is part of how we operate — not a bolt-on. International buyers can onboard us without running a separate vetting cycle.
Certifications.bsciDesc: Third-party verified working conditions, wages, and working hours across all production lines. Reports available on request.
Certifications.slcpDesc: Converged Assessment Framework recognized by major global retailers. Saves you from duplicate audits.
Certifications.aqlDesc: Every shipment inspected before dispatch. Commercial invoice, packing list, certificate of origin, and BL / AWB ready for customs.

WhoWeServe.headline: Designed for the way you go to market.
WhoWeServe.c1Desc: Multi-season programs with dedicated development teams.
WhoWeServe.c2Desc: Full white-label with custom packaging and inner-waistband branding.

FinalCTA.headline: Ready to bring your underwear line to market?
FinalCTA.description: Tell us what you're building. We'll come back with fabric options, pricing, and a realistic production timeline — within one working day.
FinalCTA.cardDesc: Share your concept, tech pack, or existing samples. We'll scope fabric, pricing, and timelines over one call.
